needs.text: ask whether Justin Bieber deserves his possessions and wealth
needs.context: Does he deserve his possesions?

needs.text: wealth, possessions, and material success
needs.context: Does he deserve his possesions?

needs.text: he earned financial rewards through hard work and commercial success from a young age
needs.context: That's a complex question with reasonable arguments on both sides. On one hand, Bieber worked incredibly hard from a young age and found huge commercial success, so he certainly earned the financial rewards of his stardom. However, others may argue that no one truly "deserves" luxury possessions given many live in poverty. Ultimately it's difficult to say definitively if anyone "deserves" their wealth or possessions. Most would agree Bieber's talent and celebrity status enabled opportunities he might not otherwise have had. As with any famous person, reasonable people can disagree on this type
